description: This file defines the Fill class within the PhpSpreadsheet Style namespace, implementing styling options for cell fills including solid colors, gradients, patterns, and their associated properties such as fill type, rotation, start color, and end color.

classes.name: Fill
classes.description: Represents cell fill styles in PHPSpreadsheet, allowing configuration of fill type, colors, rotation, and applying styles from arrays.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a Fill object, optionally as a supervisor or conditional style, and sets default start and end colors.

methods.name: getSharedComponent
methods.description: Retrieves the shared Fill component for the current cell style when acting as a supervisor.

methods.name: getStyleArray
methods.description: Builds and returns a style array from given style properties.

methods.name: applyFromArray
methods.description: Applies fill styles from an associative array, updating fill type, rotation, and colors accordingly.

methods.name: getFillType
methods.description: Returns the current fill type, considering supervisor status.

methods.name: setFillType
methods.description: Sets the fill type, updating the style if operating as a supervisor.

methods.name: setStartColor
methods.description: Sets the start color, applying changes if as supervisor.

methods.name: setEndColor
methods.description: Sets the end color, applying changes if as supervisor.

methods.name: getColorsChanged
methods.description: Indicates whether fill colors have changed.

methods.name: getHashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code representing current fill style state for comparison or caching.
